shortDescription.default: Goods receiving: record incoming material shipments with an approval workflow.

longDescription.default: Web part for the warehouse to record incoming material shipments (goods receiving), attach delivery notes, invoices, photos and inspection documents, and route records to a supervisor for approval. Data is stored in the SharePoint list "Material Receiving Records" and the library "Receiving Documents".

features.title: Goods Receiving
features.description: Adds the Goods Receiving web part.
